fields.description: Model identifier at the provider, e.g. gpt-5-mini, claude-sonnet-5-5, gemini-3.8-flash, grok-4. Pick one listed by Fetch Models or type it. For Azure OpenAI, the deployment name.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Leave empty for the provider default. Required for Azure OpenAI: https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1. Also used to route calls through a company proxy or gateway, or to reach another OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, vLLM) with a chat-completions type.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Apps built on AI Base try providers from the lowest number up and move to the next one when a provider fails or reaches its monthly cap.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Off when the model only takes text. PDFs without text are read natively by OpenAI, Claude and Gemini only.
fields.label: Reads Images

fields.description: Some reasoning models reject a temperature. Turn this off for them; the provider default is then used. Off by default for OpenAI, whose GPT-5 models accept no temperature.
fields.label: Send Temperature

fields.description: 0 gives the most repeatable answers; higher values give more varied ones. Most providers accept 0 to 1 (OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Grok up to 2).
fields.label: Temperature

fields.description: Upper limit on the tokens one answer may use, reasoning included. Long documents need more.
fields.label: Max Output Tokens per Call

fields.description: How hard a reasoning model thinks before answering: higher is more accurate on hard documents but slower and uses more tokens. Empty uses the provider default. Models that do not reason reject it.
fields.label: Reasoning Effort

fields.description: Seconds one call may take, retries of brief overloads included. Keep it below the web worker timeout (http_timeout, 120 s by default) or the request is killed; run longer work in a background job.
fields.label: Timeout per Call (s)

fields.description: Total tokens (input + output) this provider may use per calendar month. 0 means unlimited. Once reached, calls are refused until next month or until the cap is raised.
fields.label: Monthly Token Cap
